h: Runner dies after medical emergency during Lagos 10km race
p: A member of a Lagos running club has died after falling ill during a 10km race on Sunday. His club said he became dizzy at about the 6km mark and was rushed to hospital.
body: A member of an Ikeja-based running community, Team Active, has died after suffering a medical emergency during a 10km race in Lagos on Sunday.

In a statement on Instagram on Thursday, the running group said he became dizzy at about the 6km mark while running alongside other members. Fellow runners attended to him at the scene before he was taken to hospital.
The group said his death had left its members heartbroken.
more: He fell ill at about the 6km mark.
Fellow runners helped him at the scene.
His running group has paid tribute.
